source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load / Vented Dryer DV50R Family (DVE50R, DVG50R)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Touch power cord plug to discharge static before PCB work.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Before commencing with tests the appliance must be disconnected from the supply.

steps.title: Access thermal chain
steps.body: Locate thermostat 1, thermal cut-off, thermostat 2/3, and hi-limit in heat path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Locate thermostat 1, thermal cut-off, thermostat 2/3, and hi-limit in heat path.

steps.title: Thermal devices continuity
steps.body: Thermostat 1/2/3 and hi-limit — resistance < 1 Ω at room temp when closed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Thermostat 1/2/3 and hi-limit — resistance < 1 Ω at room temp when closed.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace open thermal cut-off or thermostat.

steps.title: Replace thermal cutoff
steps.oemOutcome: Replace thermal cut-off / thermostat in heat path.

steps.title: Thermal chain OK
steps.oemOutcome: Thermal devices closed — element/gas path next.
